name: Arctic kit
body:
Source Heroes of the Wild pg. 9
Price 27 gp; Weight 30 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit is designed for use in cold climates, where the weather can be deadly and the terrain treacherous. It includes 10 candles, a candle lampUE, cleatsUE, a cold-weather outfit, a handaxe, a shovel, a signal whistle, a small iron pot, snowshoesUE, and five tindertwigs, all wrapped in a winter blanket.
